name: Namerikawa (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Namerikawa city emblem in light blue and blue: a light blue ring open at the top enclosing a blue stylised mountain.
history: Municipal flag of Namerikawa, a city in Toyama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 15 June 1954.

features.role: Namerikawa city emblem — a light blue ring open at the top enclosing a blue stylised mountain
